description: Give one DOCX section its own header or footer. With paragraphs, create a new part (word/headerN.xml or word/footerN.xml) with its document relationship and content-type override and point the section's headerReference/footerReference of the given type at it; with existing_relationship_id, point the section at a part get_headers_footers already reported; with link_to_previous=true, remove the section's own reference so it inherits from the previous section. Other sections keep the header/footer they show: when the change would alter what the next section inherits, that section gets an explicit reference to its previous part (or a new empty part when it had none), reported in pinned_sections. type="first" also sets w:titlePg on the section; type="even" is shown only when even_and_odd_headers is on (the tool reports it and warns, and does not change settings). Paragraph content is text and PAGE/NUMPAGES fields with left/center/right/both alignment, using the document's Header/Footer paragraph style when it has one. Surface: package-mutation + tracked section change — new parts, relationships, content types and the header/footer references themselves are untracked and listed in the save report non-revision change manifest (w:sectPrChange cannot hold references, so rejecting revisions does not restore them); in a tracked session each changed sectPr records w:sectPrChange for its other properties, and a section with another author's pending sectPrChange is refused. Call get_sections first to find section_index (insert_section_break creates sections). DOCX only.

existing_relationship_id.description: Reuse the header/footer part of this word/document.xml relationship id.

link_to_previous.description: true: remove the section's own reference of this type so it inherits from the previous section (not allowed for section 0).

paragraphs.description: Content of a new part. Exactly one of paragraphs, existing_relationship_id or link_to_previous=true.

runs.description: Text and field runs in order, e.g. [{"text": "Page "}, {"field": "PAGE"}, {"text": " of "}, {"field": "NUMPAGES"}].

section_index.description: Zero-based session-relative index returned by get_sections or get_headers_footers.

type.description: Which header/footer of the section: default (all pages unless first/even apply), first (first page; sets w:titlePg) or even (even pages). Default: default.

name: set_header_footer
